Thursday, November 19 · 5:30 to 8:30 PM · Seattle

With Eli King

A hands-on evening for designers. We'll set up VS Code Insiders together, then take one real open-source app, Excalidraw, from a marked-up screenshot to four directions built in parallel, a demo video and a live link.

  1. 01A redesign of Excalidraw's toolbar, from your own marked-up screenshot.
  2. 02Four very different directions, built at the same time by agents.
  3. 03A pull request, a narrated demo video and your own live link.

An independent community event with UXPA Seattle. Not an official Microsoft or GitHub event. Excalidraw is open source under the MIT license, and we're not affiliated with the Excalidraw team.
